cast.characterName: 亜耶乃・ライザー・エルデューク
cast.originalCharacterName: 亜耶乃・ライザー・エルデューク

segments.text: Ayano is the president of the Tenba Conglomerate. She finds the work boring, and would rather spend her time at the bar eating Dokkoi Sets. She isn't great at her desk job, but when it comes to human relations and communication, she is excellent. She takes responsibility for the actions of her company and is ready to correct mistakes and deal with customer dis-satisfaction.
Voiced by: Yuka Shioyama (Japanese), Karen Strassman (English)
From Ar Tonelico Wiki

cast.characterName: 絢胤 箕嵩
cast.originalCharacterName: 絢胤 箕嵩

segments.text: Ayatane Michitaka is Lyner's best friend and a fellow Knight of Elemia. He is a calm, pacifistic young man who is kind and charming to everyone, prefers to approach and solve all problems with optimism, and is rarely seen without a smile on his face.

He also, rather strangely, enjoys doing domestic things such as cooking and cleaning, and dislikes crowds and fighting. Like Lyner, he fights directly under Shurelia, but unlike Lyner he seems to have deep feelings for Shurelia that border on romantic love, and he constantly worries about her no matter how much he watches over her.
Voiced by: Liam O'Brien (English)
From Ar Tonelico Wiki

cast.characterName: ボルド・レード
cast.originalCharacterName: ボルド・レード

segments.text: The second-in-command of the Tenba conglomerate. Formerly just a strong warrior and an expert in researching ruins. He was hired for his skills, and becomes a member of Tenba's ruins search team. He thinks of Reyvateil as swappable weapons and does not treat them as people. This causes clashes between him and Lyner, who respects Reyvateils as people.
He is an ambitious warrior who is the type to push over with sheer power rather than with skill. His armour is derived from both Tenba's technology and Lost Technology.
Voiced by: Richard Epcar (English)
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: クレア・ブランチ
cast.originalCharacterName: クレア・ブランチ

segments.text: A young woman who owns a bar in the airport city Nemo. She is actually a Class-B Reyvateil. Claire works at the bar by singing healing songs with her Reyvateil powers.

She has many fans in Nemo, and she gets new customers everyday. Claire believes that songs should be sung for the common people, and would never sing songs that harm others. She wants her songs to touch the hearts of people.
She is like a big sister that strictly, yet kindly, guides Lyner and the girls into doing the right thing.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: どんすけ
cast.originalCharacterName: どんすけ

segments.text: Don Leon is Aurica's mind guardian. He lives in the world inside Aurica's mind, also called her "Soulspace" or "Cosmosphere".

Don Leon is Aurica's knight. He is very loyal to her, but also headstrong. Because Aurica is hurt so often, he is always trying hard to protect her. He is originally distrusting towards Lyner, but he is helpful inside Aurica's Cosmosphere.
He looks like a stuffed lion with a crimson mantle, a sword on his hip, and a casserole pan on his head.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site and Ar Tonelico Wiki
Don Leon was originally a stuffed animal given to Aurica by Claire. Aurica's strong feelings for Don Leon gave him a physical form in her Soulspace.

cast.characterName: フラウト・ロス・ロリア
cast.originalCharacterName: フラウト・ロス・ロリア

segments.text: The leader of Em Pheyna, the town of the Teru Tribe. He follows and protects the Oath of Elemia. Flute respects Tastiella, who is very knowledgeable, and will go to her for advice for any significant event.

Although the Teru are allied friends with the Apostles of Elemia, it has been a long time since they have communicated. They no longer know of each others' situation or existence. They assume that no unusual events is good, and live their lives peacefully.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: 波摩
cast.originalCharacterName: 波摩

segments.text: Hama is Misha's mind guardian. She lives in Misha's spiritual world, known as her "soulspace" or "Cosmosphere".
Hama will not open her heart to you at first because of some past memories. Lyner must solve the mystery to the memories and Misha's past to find out about Hama's true thoughts.
She appears as a little girl with cat ears on her head, dressed in Japanese robes, and holding an ocarina.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site and Ar Tonelico Wiki
Hama was originally an ocarina that Lyner gave to Misha when they were children. Misha's strong feelings for the ocarina, which she named Hama, gave Hama a physical form in her soulspace.

cast.characterName: ジャック・ハミルトン
cast.originalCharacterName: ジャック・ハミルトン

segments.text: A wandering gunman. No one knows where he came from or what he's up to.
He travels the world, working for anyone who will hire him. That's probably why he knows so much about different places and events.
Jack seems to have his own goal for his journey, but he hasn't told anyone about it. For some reason, he actually tries to hang around Lyner during his travels.
He loves women, and even Lyner is amazed at how straightforward he is about it. He is a dependable, big brother type, to the point where he will do whatever it takes to protect his friends.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site
His real name is Harmonica De Pameli, and he is originally from the Teru Tribe.

cast.characterName: クルシェ・エレンディア
cast.originalCharacterName: クルシェ・エレンディア

segments.text: A Grathmeld engineer who lives in Firefly Alley. She knows a lot about airships and Grathnode items. Her dream is to cross the Blastline and go to the top of the tower.
She was born into a large family, and grew up unsupervised. Although she doesn't like dressing up too girly, she secretly admires it. She is kind of selfish and no-nonsense when it comes to money.
She occasionally blurts out mean jokes, but it's always in good fun.
She is only interested in airships and she'll keep researching until she makes her dreams come true.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: レアード・バルセルト
cast.originalCharacterName: レアード・バルセルト

segments.text: The commander of Platina, the Upper World of the tower. His political skills allowed him to go straight up the political ladder to his current position. He has a solid popularity among the people of Platina.

Leard is Lyner's father. He wants Lyner to succeed him, so he has tried to teach Lyner the ways of politics since he was small. However, Lyner had a strong yearning for adventure, and picked the sword over the pen.

Leard was very disappointed by this, and their relationship has been awkward since. He still has hope that Lyner might become interested in politics, but lyner has no intention, and they always end up fighting.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: リルラ・ロス・レーテル
cast.originalCharacterName: リルラ・ロス・レーテル

segments.text: A child of the Teru tribe who lives in Em Pheyna. She is a spellcaster called a Jemina, allowing her to freely teleport around the tower. She uses these abilities to run a business that searches the tower for items.
Lyra is openly in love with Jack, making everyone else suspect him of being a lolicon. However, Jack has no interest in Lyra, and actually prefers more mature girls like Claire.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site and A Reyvateil's Memory Wiki

cast.characterName: メイメイ
cast.originalCharacterName: メイメイ

segments.text: A maid droid who works at the observatory, an ancient ruin above the Blastline.
Her main job is to manage the security of the tower. She appears in front of doors as a hologram and unlocks them upon verifying that the person attempting to enter is allowed access.
She is often sleepy and needs to sleep often to recharge her power.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site and A Reyvateil's Memory Wiki

cast.characterName: ミュール
cast.originalCharacterName: ミュール

segments.text: Voiced by: Mary Elizabeth McGlynn (English)

Mir is a Reyvateil created by humans to have no emotions, as her creators believed that this would result in a stronger Reyvateil. However, she developed emotions over time, which displeased her creators.

Because of her treatment as a tool by humans, she loathed them, and planned to exterminate them to create a world only for Reyvateils. Even after she was sealed by Shurelia and Tastiella, she retained her hatred for humans.
From Ar Tonelico Wiki and A Reyvateil's Memory Wiki

cast.characterName: スピカ・ニール
cast.originalCharacterName: スピカ・ニール

segments.text: The innocent-looking girl who sells Kitty Candy in Firefly Alley's central commercial district. However, her Kitty Candy business is just a cover for her hidden business as an informant, trading in risky information. She also sells very rare and expensive Grathnode crystals.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: ラードルフ・シュナイゼン
cast.originalCharacterName: ラードルフ・シュナイゼン

segments.text: A resident of the Lower World, and a Cardinal of the Elemia Church. His skills are among the best in the Church, especially with his sword.

Sympathizing with the Church's beliefs that "people should live in peace and harmony", he joined the Church when he was 16. He had a natural talent with the sword, and in five years, climbed to the highest rank of commander (Cardinal) within the knights of the Church.

A serious guy who takes pride in the happiness and protection that the Church's missions bring to the people. He can be stubborn at times, and he won't go back on his word. Unlike most other leaders in the Church, he doesn't believe that the Goddesses' descent is a priority.
Voiced by: Masakazu Handa (Japanese), Vic Mignogna (English)
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: タスティエーラ・デ・ルゥ
cast.originalCharacterName: タスティエーラ・デ・ルゥ

segments.text: As the oldest person in Em Pheyna, she is a well respected woman, and always consulted by Flute before he does anything big. She is quiet and seems like she has insight to everything.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site and A Reyvateil's Memory Wiki

Tastiella was originally a high priestess of Em Pheyna during the Second Era. According to Shurelia, she sacrificed herself in order to seal Mir. She now acts as the Crescent Chronicle's terminal to oversee the physical world and therefore can only move within Em Pheyna and the Crescent Chronicle. Her "body" is severely damaged later in the game, but she manages to oversee the end of Lyner's journey and congratulate him, before bidding farewell and disappearing, thus dying as she wished.
From Ar Tonelico Wiki

cast.characterName: ファルス司祭
cast.originalCharacterName: ファルス司祭

segments.text: A High priest of the Elemia Church. He acts as the leader of all the churches on each floating island., including Nemo. He was not originally from the area, but ever since he joined the Elemia Church, people called him the Saint of Elemia Church. After 15 years, he reached the top of the Church's heirarchy.
He is full of affection and believes the goal of the Church is to descend the goddess of the Trio of Elemia to lead people to happiness.
Voiced by: Susumu Kaseda (Japanese), Jamieson Price (English)
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site
His real name is Kyle Clancy, and he was previously a leader in Platina with Leard. He was exiled for attempting to ally with Mir.

cast.characterName: ガルツベルン・ルク・ラルド
cast.originalCharacterName: ガルツベルン・ルク・ラルド

segments.text: A drakanoid who lives in a place called the Dragon's Nest near the top of the tower.
He has a long life, and has many items from the past. Drakanoids have conflicts with each other too, and it seems he is currently in a territorial argument with a rival.
From Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: ライナー・バルセルト
cast.originalCharacterName: ライナー・バルセルト

segments.text: A very energetic young man with an adventurer's spirit. Although he often overreacts, he is hesitant (or just indecisive) when it comes to relationships, and doesn't react well when girls take the initiative. He's a simple guy who hates dishonest people. He has a strong sense of responsibility, which often gets him in trouble.

He was born in the city of Platina in the upper levels of the tower. His father is the current Commander of Platina, who tries to teach him the ways of politics. However, Lyner has no interest in politics whatsoever, and decided to pick up the sword to search for adventure.

He was acknowledged for his great potential, and was selected to become a Knight of Elemia and protect Shurelia, the administrator of the tower. He continues to serve Shurelia, helping to defeat the Viruses within the tower.
Edited from Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: オリカ・ネストミール
cast.originalCharacterName: オリカ・ネストミール

segments.text: Aurica used to be a cheerful and kind person, but because of the many traumas in her past, her expressions tend to be sad and gloomy.
She is a Reyvateil, a person who has the power to change sound into magic. More specifically, she is a mix between a Reyvateil and a human, known as a Third Generation Reyvateil.

Her parents passed away a few years ago during an attack on Skuwat Village. She then joined the Elemia Church, who enshrined the Trio of Elemia. She decided to work there as a candidate for the Holy Maiden, but because she was not very talented, she did not fare very well. She still admires Claire, the young lady who always played with her when she was a child.
From Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: 彌紗・アルトセルク・リューン
cast.originalCharacterName: 彌紗・アルトセルク・リューン

segments.text: Misha is an honest and single-minded girl at heart. Though she acts more mature than she looks, you can't deny that she's quite childish.

She is a Reyvateil, a person who has the power to change sound into magic. More specifically, she is a very rare kind, called a Pureblooded β-type. Because of this, she has very strong, innate powers.

Despite her looks, she is bright, intelligent, and actually quite good at cooking. With her ability to calmly analyze her surroundings, she can do anything skillfully, but she has horrible physical reflexes (she's a klutz). She is also afraid of heights.

She was born in Platina, a city located in the Upper World of the tower, but she is currently living in the Lower World. She seems to know Lyner. She also seems to look much younger than she should be...
From Ar Tonelico Official Site

cast.characterName: シュレリア
cast.originalCharacterName: シュレリア

segments.text: The administrator of the tower. She usually stays in the Rinkernator, the upper most location in the tower. She often comes down to Platina, where the Apostles of Elemia live.
When there is a serious Virus outbreak, she takes Lyner and the other Knights of Elemia to destroy them.
She is usually covered in her armor. Because of her role, she must stay calm and never involve personal matters in decision making. A mysterious person surrounded in a veil of armour.
From Ar Tonelico Official Site
